title: Hearty Velvety Filipino Grass Halo Halo
description: A show-off Filipino dessert featuring dried red chillies and a salt-bake crust, this paleo-friendly halo halo is a unique twist on a classic dish. The combination of grassy and velvety textures creates a truly one-of-a-kind dessert experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit to prepare for salt-baking.
In a small bowl, mix together the crushed dried red chillies and salt.
Spread the chilli-salt mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the coconut milk, palm sugar, and lemon juice, and stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the diced grass jelly and jackfruit to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whip the coconut cream until it forms stiff peaks.
Fold the whipped coconut cream into the grass jelly mixture until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Top each serving with a spoonful of the crushed ice and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Drizzle with a small amount of coconut milk, if desired, and serve immediately.
